ld.heroSub: Meet ASHA Swar Nirantar — your intelligent voice companion for easier healthcare fieldwork.
ld.qrDecorative: The holographic QR is a decorative visual — it is not a scannable beneficiary code.
ld.featuresSub: Lengthy registers become simple conversations. The system connects what it hears into living health histories.
ld.f1.title: Voice-first recording
ld.f1.body: Record pregnancy visits, newborn details, immunisations and follow-ups by speaking naturally — no lengthy typing in the field.
ld.f2.body: Every record connects through a unique beneficiary ID — a longitudinal timeline of ANC checkups, weights, vaccines and newborn visits.
ld.f3.body: Deterministic rules quietly surface overdue checkups, missed vaccination schedules and missing expected records for timely follow-up.
ld.f4.title: Safe danger-sign detection
ld.f4.body: Detects approved warning phrases with correct negation handling, shows the exact triggering phrase, and says: refer to PHC as per approved guidelines.
ld.f5.title: Smart reminders
ld.f5.body: Schedule pregnancy checkups, vaccination and newborn follow-up reminders — with consent-based, non-sensitive SMS notifications.
ld.f6.title: QR beneficiary profiles
ld.f6.body: Each beneficiary carries an anonymous QR identity. Scan to open their connected history — never health data inside the code itself.
ld.s1: Understand the ASHA worker's voice — in her language, with natural code-mixing.
ld.s2: Maintain connected health histories so no detail is ever lost between visits.
ld.s3: Identify predefined danger signs and support timely, guideline-backed follow-ups.
ld.w1b: “Visited Lakshmi today. She is 28 weeks pregnant. Blood pressure is 120 over 80. Weight is 53 kilograms.”
ld.w2b: Gnani Prisma v3.0 streams the speech into text, live and language-aware.
ld.w3b: The LLM structures the fields — beneficiary, weeks, BP, weight, visit date.
ld.w4b: A deterministic rules engine checks danger signs and follow-up status. It never diagnoses.
ld.w5b: Gnani Timbre v3.0 speaks the record aloud. The worker corrects by voice — only the stated field changes.
ld.w6b: Only after explicit confirmation. The visit joins the Pulse Thread and reminders can be scheduled.
ld.benefitsBody: ASHA workers are the heartbeat of village healthcare. Their time belongs with people — not registers. ASHA Swar Nirantar turns the field register into a conversation, keeps every history connected, and watches quietly over every follow-up.
ld.b1.title: For ANC visits
ld.b1.body: Weeks of pregnancy, BP, weight and haemoglobin captured in seconds — read back and confirmed before saving.
ld.b2.title: For newborns
ld.b2.body: Birth details, feeding, jaundice checks and weight tracking joined to the mother's thread.
ld.b3.title: For immunisation
ld.b3.body: Every dose recorded with the next due date — missed schedules surface automatically.
ld.b4.title: For follow-ups
ld.b4.body: Pulse Drift shows overdue checkups and suggested actions; reminders go out with consent.
ld.taraBody: “I've saved Lakshmi's visit — 28 weeks, BP 120/80, weight 54 kg. Her next ANC checkup is due in 12 days. Shall I schedule a reminder?”
ld.threadBody: Mother & child histories, connected by one anonymous QR identity — visible in a single glance.
ld.safetyBody: Rule-based danger-sign detection using the approved list. Tara never diagnoses — she flags verified phrases: “Refer to PHC as per approved guidelines.”
ld.readyBody: Sign in and start your first voice visit. Tara is waiting to listen.
ld.footerLine: Every Voice Matters. Every Life Counts. · Synthetic demo data only

help.title: Help
help.step1: Open Voice, tap the mic and speak naturally. Tara transcribes, extracts and reads it back before anything is saved.
help.step2: Use QR Scanner to open a beneficiary or household by their card — the code holds an anonymous ID only.
help.step3: Pulse Drift lists deterministic overdue items. Unchanged values are flagged for verification, never diagnosed.
help.step4: Approved warning phrases are flagged verbatim with a fixed referral message. Tara never diagnoses.
